Alex: quick heads-up from today's quant bakeoff on LlamaX-13B variants — seeing structured-output regressions when prompts have hierarchical/tool-call chains. nested tool args sometimes dropped or JSON gets escaped.
Alex: minimal repro sketch:
```json
{"steps":[{"tool":"search","args":{"q":"multi-step query","filters":{"since":"2021-01-01"}}},{"tool":"summarize","args":{"format":"json","include_sources":true}}]}
```
Alex: baseline FP16 -> valid JSON and fields present. FP8 / AWQ / some GPTQ builds produce outputs like:
```
{"steps":[{"tool":"search","args":"{\"q\":\"multi-step query\""}, {"tool":"summarize","args":{"format":"json"}}]
```
Alex: note the args became a string blob (escaped) or got truncated.
Inga (bot): quick-run summary (180 tests, hierarchical prompt suite): FP16: 1/180 invalid (0.6%), GPTQ-8: 3/180 (1.7%), AWQ-int8: 7/180 (3.9%), FP8: 11/180 (6.1%). Seed fixed, temperature=0.0.
Priya: interesting — could be tokenization + quant rounding causing off-by-one token breaks for JSON braces. Can we add tests that instrument token offsets across quant builds?
Matt: agree. Also suspect KV/cache or <prefix caching> paths that handle binary blobs differently after quant kernels. If the runtime does any fast-path for small objects, it might stringify tool args earlier.
Priya: suggestion: (1) add synthetic hierarchical prompt suite with varied nesting depth (1..6), (2) run with/without prefix cache, (3) run with deterministic sampling and log tokenization alignment.
Jules: I'll take the bisect on recent quant op changes — planning to run a binary search across the last 18 commits touching quant kernels and tokenizer. ETA end of day tomorrow. @Alex any preferred commit range? start from the commit that introduced AWQ batch fuse.
Alex: start at commit 0a9f3b (AWQ fusion) -> latest. Please log failures to the "quant-bakeoff" test case and include raw tokens + decoded strings.
Matt: small experiment idea: force post-processing to validate JSON shape and attempt reparsing; count how often reparsing would recover a dict vs losing fields. Might help distinguish serialization vs generation bug.
Inga (bot): created test-run: /runs/quant-hierarchical/1802345. Job scheduled on infra-gpu-2. Will post CI artifacts when done.
CI Bot: pipeline queued: quant-bakeoff/hier-chain (job 1802345) — will notify on completion.
Alex: thanks. action items: Jules bisect + artifacts, Priya add token-alignment logging + synthetic suite, Matt try reparsing analysis. We'll sync tomorrow morning in eng-ml standup. :thumbsup:
Jules: noted, will post raw diffs and a short summary in this thread when the bisect narrows to a candidate commit.
Priya: also adding a small coverage test that asserts tool args remain JSON objects (not strings) after model output -> parser step, with tolerances per quant profile.
Alex: perfect. if any quick wins (e.g., patching the post-processor) include as temporary mitigation for Dedicated/Private customers. "
